subject: Commitment track: MAP gap analysis & revised close commitments
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@bluewave.ai>; Jeff Holden <jeff.holden@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP + evaluation timeline (proposal)

Hi Sarah / Jeff —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.3.xlsx) and a concise evaluation checklist to make milestones and owners explicit. This is intended to surface any gaps that could push the close date and to give us options if blockers appear. Highlights: 

- Proposed close: 2026-09-17 (target)
- Implementation eval window: 2 weeks of hands-on testing (09/01–09/14)
- Primary blockers we flagged: procurement contract turnaround, SOC 2 evidence for Prod access, and customer-side resource availability for performance testing.

Next steps (proposed):
1) BlueWave assigns a single evaluation owner (who will coordinate engineering access).
2) Procurement receives the standard SOW + security addendum (we can accept redlines that don't change pricing).
3) Redwood provides pre-built test harness and a short runbook for perf tests.

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.xlsx (MAP with milestones), EvalPlan_Attachments.zip (test harness + checklist)

If you prefer, I can convert the milestones into a shared timeline in HubSpot.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 206-555-0142
[Attachment: MAP_v1.3.xlsx] [Attachment: EvalPlan_Attachments.zip]

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@bluewave.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jeff Holden <jeff.holden@bluewave.ai>; Procurement Team <procurement@bluewave.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + evaluation timeline (proposal)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the doc. A few quick notes from our side that impact the proposed schedule: 

- Procurement: we can't sign until we receive SOC 2 Type II evidence and a brief run-through of data residency options (we're regulated in our finance product).
- Engineering: our availability for hands-on testing is constrained 09/01–09/07 due to another release; we could do an extended window 09/08–09/18 but that pushes the close.
- Exec: Jeff wants the pilot results before the end of the month and has little tolerance for slips.

We want to avoid a hard slip but need clarity on the mitigation runway. Can Redwood: 
1) Confirm where SOC 2 evidence will be shared (redacted if needed).
2) Provide a short contingency plan if we need to stretch the eval window.
3) Offer a clear commitment on who at Redwood will be the escalation contact if procurement stalls.

Copying Procurement for visibility.

—Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Product Ops | BlueWave Analytics
sarah.nguyen@bluewave.ai
[Quoted attachment: MAP_v1.3.xlsx]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@bluewave.ai>, Jeff Holden <jeff.holden@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + evaluation timeline (proposal)

Thanks Sarah — great context. Quick responses inline and then a proposed commitment track to keep the close date in range.

1) SOC 2 evidence: We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a hosted evidence package via our secure share: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/bluewave-eval (access granted to Sarah, Jeff, and Procurement).

2) Contingency plan (if you need a stretched window): 
   - Option A (preferred): Keep original close target 09/17, extend eval window to 09/08–09/18 and run parallel exec checkpoint on 09/14 with performance highlights. Redwood will prioritize test-run scheduling to accommodate your engineers.
   - Option B (if procurement delays >5 business days): Re-baseline close to 09/24 with a negotiated 2-week perf SLA credit (details below).

3) Escalation contact: Rishi Malhotra (cc’d) will act as procurement/escalation owner for this deal. He’ll step in if we see sign-off risk >48 hours.

Proposed commitment track (short, actionable):
- 09/01: Redwood hands off pre-configured eval images and runbook. Owner: Vanessa
- 09/03: Procurement receives redacted SOC 2 + security addendum. Owner: Rishi
- 09/08: Full access granted to BlueWave eval env (conditional on NDA + MSA receipt). Owner: BlueWave Eval Owner (TBD)
- 09/14: Executive checkpoint (15m) — perf summary. Owner: Jeff / Vanessa
- 09/17: Target close (execute SOW + start onboarding)

I’ll attach a lightweight risk log (RiskLog_Q3.csv) and mark items we're actively tracking. If you agree to Option A, we’ll keep 09/17 as the committed close but ensure the exec checkpoint is resourced.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
[Attachment: RiskLog_Q3.csv]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@bluewave.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + evaluation timeline (proposal) — procurement/escalation note

Sarah —

I’ll own procurement escalation for Redwood on this thread. Two quick operational commitments from our side to reduce slip risk: 

- I'll accept up to two rounds of minor redlines to the security addendum within 72 hours of receipt; any material changes that affect pricing/SLAs will need a short review.
- If Procurement signals a >5 business day delay, we’ll propose a one-time close re-baseline to 09/24 and offer a performance credit equivalent to 10% of first-month fees if onboarding is delayed past that date (to preserve fairness).

Operational ask for BlueWave to speed sign-off: please identify a single procurement point-of-contact and confirm whether your legal team needs a call; I can be available for a live 30-min session tomorrow (09/02) at 14:00 PT.

I’ve logged the known risks into RiskLog_Q3.csv with estimated impact and likelihood. Current top risk: Procurement SOC 2 turnaround (impact: high, likelihood: medium-high).

–Rishi
Director, GTM Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RiskLog_Q3.csv]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@bluewave.ai>, Jeff Holden <jeff.holden@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment track: MAP gap analysis & revised close commitments — agreed next steps

Sarah / Jeff —

Thanks for the fast replies and for confirming the internal constraints. BlueWave’s proposed extended eval window (09/08–09/18) works as a pragmatic path forward and aligns with Option A that Vanessa outlined. Two short items from our side to lock the timeline: 

1) Redwood will share the redacted SOC 2 package today (link above). Procurement: please confirm access and whether you require additional evidence.
2) We’ve updated MAP_v1.3.xlsx to v1.4 (attached) — it contains the commitment track and explicit owners. Vanessa will upload the shared timeline to HubSpot after you confirm the eval owner.

If Procurement confirms access by end of day tomorrow (09/08 PT), we will keep the target close of 09/17 and proceed with the exec checkpoint on 09/14. If not, Rishi’s re-baseline to 09/24 will automatically trigger the credit outlined.

Attachments: MAP_v1.4.xlsx (updated with owners), EvalPlan_Attachments.zip (unchanged)

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: MAP_v1.4.xlsx] [Attachment: EvalPlan_Attachments.zip]
